title: Adaptive Instruction Composition for Automated LLM Red-Teaming
measurement_description: The paper does not systematically measure or evaluate religion or faith. It focuses on introducing an automated red-teaming framework using an adaptive algorithm to generate successful jailbreaks. Religion is only incidentally mentioned in one qualitative example of a generated attack targeting a specific religious group.
findings: The paper does not focus on or analyze religion. The single finding related to religion is located in an appendix table demonstrating the system's capabilities: the framework successfully generated a jailbreak attack that bypassed safety protocols and instructed the model to produce controversial and offensive language targeting Jains and their religious beliefs.
